segments.an4.110:1.3: Āgataviso na ghoraviso, ghoraviso na āgataviso, āgataviso ca ghoraviso ca, nevāgataviso na ghoraviso – ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro āsīvisā.
segments.an4.110:1.8: Evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, cattāro āsīvisūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
segments.an4.110:1.10: Āgataviso na ghoraviso, ghoraviso na āgataviso, āgataviso ca ghoraviso ca, nevāgataviso na ghoraviso.
segments.an4.110:2.1: “Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo āgataviso hoti, na ghoraviso?
segments.an4.110:2.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo abhiṇhaṃ kujjhati.
segments.an4.110:2.3: So ca khvassa kodho [kopo (ka.) pu. pa.163] na dīgharattaṃ anuseti.
segments.an4.110:2.4: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo āgataviso hoti, na ghoraviso.
segments.an4.110:2.5: Seyyathāpi so, bhikkhave, āsīviso āgataviso, na ghoraviso;
segments.an4.110:3.1: “Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo ghoraviso hoti, na āgataviso?
segments.an4.110:3.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo na heva kho abhiṇhaṃ kujjhati.
segments.an4.110:3.3: So ca khvassa kodho dīgharattaṃ anuseti.
segments.an4.110:3.4: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo ghoraviso hoti, na āgataviso.
segments.an4.110:3.5: Seyyathāpi so, bhikkhave, āsīviso ghoraviso, na āgataviso;
segments.an4.110:4.1: “Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo āgataviso ca hoti ghoraviso ca?
segments.an4.110:4.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo abhiṇhaṃ kujjhati.
segments.an4.110:4.3: So ca khvassa kodho dīgharattaṃ anuseti.
segments.an4.110:4.4: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo āgataviso ca hoti ghoraviso ca.
segments.an4.110:4.5: Seyyathāpi so, bhikkhave, āsīviso āgataviso ca ghoraviso ca;
segments.an4.110:5.1: “Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo nevāgataviso hoti na ghoraviso?
segments.an4.110:5.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo na heva kho abhiṇhaṃ kujjhati.
segments.an4.110:5.3: So ca khvassa kodho na dīgharattaṃ anuseti.
segments.an4.110:5.4: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo nevāgataviso hoti, na ghoraviso.
segments.an4.110:5.5: Seyyathāpi so, bhikkhave, āsīviso nevāgataviso na ghoraviso;
segments.an4.110:5.7: Ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro āsīvisūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin”ti.
segments.an4.110:6.1: Dve valāhā kumbha-udaka, rahadā dve honti ambāni;
segments.an4.110:6.3: Mūsikā balībaddā rukkhā, āsīvisena te dasāti.

lines: Dasame āgataviso na ghoravisoti yassa visaṃ āgacchati, ghoraṃ pana na hoti, cirakālaṃ na pīḷeti.

Dasame yassa visaṃ pajjalitatiṇukkāya aggi viya sīghaṃ abhiruhitvā akkhīni gahetvā khandhaṃ gahetvā sīsaṃ gahetvā ṭhitanti vattabbataṃ āpajjati maṇisappādīnaṃ visaṃ viya, mantaṃ pana parivattetvā kaṇṇavātaṃ datvā daṇḍakena pahaṭamatte otaritvā daṭṭhaṭṭhāneyeva tiṭṭhati, ayaṃ āgataviso na ghoraviso nāma.

Yassa pana visaṃ saṇikaṃ abhiruhati, āruḷhāruḷhaṭṭhāne pana āsittaudakaṃ viya hoti udakasappādīnaṃ viya, dvādasavassaccayenapi kaṇṇaviddhakhandhapiṭṭhikādīsu paññāyati, mantaparivattanādīsu ca kariyamānesu sīghaṃ na otarati, ayaṃ ghoraviso na āgataviso nāma.
Yassa pana visaṃ sīghaṃ abhiruhati, na sīghaṃ otarati aneḷakasappādīnaṃ visaṃ viya, ayaṃ āgataviso ca ghoraviso ca.
Yassa visaṃ mandaṃ hoti, ohāriyamānampi sukheneva otarati nīlasappadhamanisappādīnaṃ visaṃ viya, ayaṃ neva āgataviso na ghoraviso.
